name: azure-pipelines-tasks-trivy
description: Azure DevOps tasks to install and scan with Aqua Trivy

scripts.check: node tools/prepare.js && node --check lib/ado.js && node --check lib/cli.js && node --check lib/installer.js && node --check TrivyInstaller/index.js && node --check TrivyScan/index.js && node --test tests/*.test.js
scripts.package:vsix: node tools/prepare.js && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path dist
